llm.reply:
The retrieved records link two genes to inherited colorectal cancer risk, but they do not say which gene underlies which condition, so a gene-by-gene comparison is not possible from them. The first gene is NCBIGene:4292, mutL homolog 1 [1]. The second gene is NCBIGene:4436, mutS homolog 2 [5].

## Associated Hereditary Syndromes

One condition retrieved for these genes is Lynch syndrome 1 [6]. Another is Colorectal cancer, hereditary nonpolyposis, type 2 [3]. A further condition is Muir-TorrÃ© syndrome [2]. Mismatch repair cancer syndrome 1 was also retrieved [4]. Mismatch repair cancer syndrome 2 was retrieved as well [7].

## MLH1 Molecular Function

The mutL homolog 1 protein pairs with PMS2 to form part of the DNA repair machinery [18: "heterodimerize with mismatch repair endonuclease PMS2 to form MutL alpha, part of the DNA mismatch repair system"]. This gene is repeatedly altered in hereditary colon cancer [18: "identified as a locus frequently mutated in hereditary nonpolyposis colon cancer (HNPCC)"]. Its annotated processes include GO:0006298, mismatch repair [21].

## Supporting Literature and Trials

One study examined mismatch-repair-deficient tumours [27]. One trial studies MK-3475 in microsatellite-unstable tumours [19]. The retrieved records hold no equivalent functional summary for NCBIGene:4436, so its role cannot be compared in the same detail [5].

The retrieved records compare two mismatch repair genes, NCBIGene:4292 (mutL homolog 1) [1] and NCBIGene:4436 (mutS homolog 2) [5]. The conditions retrieved alongside them are hereditary cancer syndromes, but the records do not say which condition belongs to which gene, so they cannot rank the two genes' colorectal cancer risk.

## Associated hereditary syndromes

One retrieved condition is Colorectal cancer, hereditary nonpolyposis, type 2 [3]. Another is Lynch syndrome 1 [6]. Another is Muir-TorrÃ© syndrome [2]. Another is Mismatch repair cancer syndrome 1 [4]. Another is Mismatch repair cancer syndrome 2 [7].

## MLH1 function and records

The gene symbol is MLH1 [8]. The gene name is MLH1 [12]. The OMIM entry is DNA MISMATCH REPAIR PROTEIN MLH1; MLH1 [11]. Its product partners with PMS2 in DNA repair [18: "can heterodimerize with mismatch repair endonuclease PMS2 to form MutL alpha, part of the DNA mismatch repair system"]. It was linked to inherited colon cancer [18: "identified as a locus frequently mutated in hereditary nonpolyposis colon cancer (HNPCC)"]. Its annotated processes include mismatch repair [21]. They also include meiotic mismatch repair [15]. They also include response to stress [26].

## Variants and literature

One ClinVar variant is NM_000249.4(MLH1):c.545+1271_677+737delinsCA [10]. Another is NM_000249.4(MLH1):c.453+625_545+920delinsT [17]. Another is NM_000249.4(MLH1):c.1418A>T (p.His473Leu) [23]. Another is NM_000249.4(MLH1):c.884+5T>A [28]. One paper is Functional analysis of human MLH1 variants using yeast and in vitro mismatch repair assays. [16]. Another is Clinicopathological and molecular characterization of deficient mismatch repair colorectal cancer. [27]. Another is MLH1/PMS2-deficient Endometrial Carcinomas in a Universally Screened Population: MLH1 Hypermethylation and Germline Mutation Status. [22]. Another is Association between the MLH1 gene and longevity. [9]. Related publications include PMID 16474933 [14]. They also include PMID 17510385 [20]. They also include PMID 33577226 [25]. They also include PMID 36150551 [30].

## Clinical trials

One related trial is Study of MK-3475 in Patients With Microsatellite Unstable (MSI) Tumors (Cohorts A, B and C) [19]. Another is The IMPACT Study - Identification of Men With a Genetic Predisposition to ProstAte Cancer [13]. Another is Surgery in Preventing Ovarian Cancer in Patients With Genetic Mutations [24]. Another is Stand up to Cancer: MAGENTA (Making Genetic Testing Accessible) [29].
